## How to cite

If this material helped your research, teaching or project:

> Beltran, L. A. (2026). *TROPOMI CH4 Brasil: tutorial e código para séries de
> metano do Sentinel-5P*. https://github.com/LudimiladeAzevedoBeltran/tropomi-ch4-brasil

The [`CITATION.cff`](https://github.com/LudimiladeAzevedoBeltran/tropomi-ch4-brasil/blob/main/CITATION.cff)
file lets GitHub generate the citation (a **"Cite this repository"** button).

## Licenses

| Content | License |
|---|---|
| Code (`tropomi_ch4/`, notebooks) | **MIT** |
| Text and figures (this site, README) | **CC BY 4.0** |

- MIT: use, modify and share the code, keeping the copyright notice.
- CC BY 4.0: reuse the text/figures **crediting the author**.

## Data

Sentinel-5P/TROPOMI — **ESA / Copernicus**. Accessed via Copernicus Data Space
Ecosystem (Statistical API) and Google Earth Engine. Check the providers' terms
when redistributing data.
